人们希望，那只被困在牢狱中的怪物

the creature would age and perish.
But time would not touch the fiend.

flavor.zh-Hant:
一名出身平凡的普通士兵，在每次艱苦的行軍後，
仍持續鍛打至深夜，他的雙眼燃燒著星光與決心。
幾乎沒人猜想到，有朝一日他會成為他們之中最偉大的人。
flavor.zh-Hans:
一个平民出身的普通士兵，每次残酷行军后
依然在深夜苦练，双眼燃烧着星火般的决心。
没人料到他日后会成为众人之中的传奇。
flavor.en:
A common soldier from a common family kept hammering into the night
after each grueling march, his eyes afire with starlight and determination.
Few suspected that he would one day become the greatest among them.

flavor.zh-Hant:
一名出身平凡的普通士兵，在每次艱苦的行軍後，
仍持續鍛打至深夜，他的雙眼燃燒著星光與決心。
幾乎沒人猜想到，有朝一日他會成為他們之中最偉大的人。
flavor.zh-Hans:
一个平民出身的普通士兵，每次残酷行军后
依然在深夜苦练，双眼燃烧着星火般的决心。
没人料到他日后会成为众人之中的传奇。
flavor.en:
A common soldier from a common family kept hammering into the night
after each grueling march, his eyes afire with starlight and determination.
Few suspected that he would one day become the greatest among them.

flavor.zh-Hant:
你們這些凡人真是陰險。你們壓抑自己的
邪惡，或否認它存在。騙子！當我剖開
你們的腦袋，那股暴戾便會傾瀉而出。
— 渡鴉欺詐者
flavor.zh-Hans:
“凡人真是阴险。
要么压抑内心的邪恶，要么否认它的存在。一群骗子！
等我打开你们的脑袋，那暴力便会奔涌而出。”
— 黑鸦欺诈者
flavor.en:
"You mortals are insidious. You repress your
evil, or deny it exists. Liars! When I open
your heads, that violence floods out."
- The Raven Trickster

info.en: Draws out the latent fears of enemies you kill and Rare or Unique enemies you Hit, turning them into unstable apparitions which charge towards enemies and then explode.

lines.en: Unstable Apparitions spawned from slain enemies deal 8 % of that enemy's Life as added unscalable Physical damage

lines.zh-Hant: 不穩定鬼魂源自的敵人每有 1 強度，即會造成 5 % 更多傷害

lines.en: Draws out an Unstable Apparition from Rare or Unique enemies you Hit

lines.en: Draws out an Unstable Apparition from enemies you kill with Melee Hits, no more than once every 0.05 seconds
